publisher: United States Department of Agriculture, Food Safety and Inspection Service
ownership: United States federal government public establishment directory and demographic data
source_access: Public anonymous read-only CSV download links. This connector accepts explicitly supplied official files because FSIS edge controls reject unattended HTTP and fresh headless clients in the validated environment.
allowed_use: redistribution of approved normalized fields with attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: evading FSIS access controls or disguising automated clients
representing active-directory membership as independent proof of general business operating status, public access, current hours, ownership, or every product made
representing FSIS coverage as all food businesses or all U.S. businesses
inferring a legal organization or parent company from establishment name or DBA text
merging establishments across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection Directory and Establishment Demographic Data.
retention: Indefinite for immutable source and normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved normalized public business records may be redistributed with FSIS attribution, source date, both source checksums, provenance, temporal scope, and coverage limitations retained; raw source CSVs remain internal.
